branch: stopHookFeedback / stopHookBlock / lastBlock and the stop-hook-error guard in bannerLine (50-blocks.js); the text branch of onUserEvent (75-retraction.js); the 'stophook' status icon in 55-replay.js; LIMITS.stopHookPrefix (RenderLimits.kt)
provenance: The `user` frame and the `system/notification` frame of step 1 are TAPED VERBATIM (2026-11-22, CLI 2.1.330, stdio with the panel's flags plus --settings holding one Stop hook that blocks the first stop, haiku; tape _local/probe-3/tape-stop-1.jsonl): after the first reply's message_stop came the user frame and, in the same 10 ms, the notification, then the second request. The two assistant frames are that tape's, cut to the keys read; the result frame is cut the same way. Step 2's reversed order (notification first) was NOT seen on the wire — it is drawn by hand to pin that either order ends in one block. The replay items of step 3 are OUR OWN Kotlin→page shape (SessionStore: the META user record that probe's transcript holds, string content, same text). Step 4's three frames are TAPED VERBATIM (same day and setup with TWO blocking Stop hooks, tape _local/probe-3/tape-stop-two.jsonl): each hook's message is a user frame of its own, 10 ms apart, followed by one notification. The second replay item of step 3 (no [command]: lead) is hand-made.
